output.summary: A perennial coastal flowering plant found across much of Europe, Macaronesia, parts of West Asia and North Africa. Its woody-based stems and divided leaves are fleshy; fresh leaves are eaten in salads, while stems and leaves are cooked and several parts are pickled.
output.edibilityNote: Fresh leaves are eaten in salads; stems and leaves are cooked, and stems, leaves and young seed pods are pickled in several European traditions.
